import re
pairs=[]
for rec in records:
 m=rec.get('message',{})
 if m.get('role')!='user': continue
 txt='\n'.join(x.get('text','') for x in m.get('content',[]) if isinstance(x,dict))
 for mm in re.finditer(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \1 output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\nWrong attempts|\Z)',txt,re.S):
  n,h,w,ins,outs=mm.groups()
  def rows(s): return [[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in s.strip().splitlines()]
  gi,go=rows(ins),rows(outs)
  pairs.append((int(n),gi,go))
print('pairs',len(pairs),[(n,len(i),len(i[0]),len(o)) for n,i,o in pairs])
for n,i,o in pairs:
 pred=mod.transform(i)
 if pred!=o:
  print('mismatch',n)
  # counts diff
  dif=[(r,c,pred[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if pred[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
  print(dif[:15],len(dif))
